mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(MESSAGE_ORDER), -1) FROM `AI_CONVERSATION` WHERE DELETED = 0 AND MEMORY_KEY = #{messageKey}

SELECT AC.*, AM.MODEL_NAME AS modelName, AA.AGENT_NAME AS agentName, AP.PROMPT_TITLE AS promptTitle FROM `AI_CONVERSATION` AC LEFT JOIN `AI_MODEL` AM ON AC.MODEL_KEY = AM.MODEL_KEY LEFT JOIN `AI_AGENT` AA ON AC.AGENT_KEY = AA.AGENT_KEY LEFT JOIN `AI_PROMPT` AP ON AC.PROMPT_KEY = AP.PROMPT_KEY WHERE AC.MEMORY_KEY = #{memoryKey} ORDER BY AC.UPDATE_TIME ASC
SELECT MODEL_KEY AS modelKey, SUM(CONSUME_TOKENS) AS total FROM `AI_CONVERSATION` WHERE CREATE_TIME >= CURDATE() AND DELETED = 0 AND ENV_CODE = #{envCode} GROUP BY MODEL_KEY
